name: Earth Dragon Slayer
description: (Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of an earth dragon. You generate, control, alter earth such as denser, tougher, and heavier, devour earth, and are immune to earth-based attacks below your level. Devouring earth and rocks recovers vitality and energy based on rock quality, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your earth.
